9500.commentary: (VINa) asabhāgavuttikā'ti visabhāgajīvikā, yathā bhikkhūsu vattitabbaṃ, evaṃ appavattavuttino'ti attho.

examples.text: so vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu agāravo appatisso asabhāgavuttiko sabrahmacārīsu ābhisamācārikaṃ dhammaṃ paripūressatī'ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. ābhisamācārikaṃ dhammaṃ aparipūretvā sekhaṃ dhammaṃ paripūressatī'ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū upāsake padaso dhammaṃ vācenti. upāsakā bhikkhūsu agāravā appatissā asabhāgavuttikā viharanti. ye te bhikkhū app'icchā … te ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti, kathañ'hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū upāsake padaso dhammaṃ vācessanti!

9518.commentary: (SNt) asamapekkhite'ti sammādassane rūpe manāpabhāvaṃ amanāpabhāvañ'ca gahetvā, idaṃ nāma mayā diṭṭhan'ti anupadhārentassa kevalaṃ samūhaghanavasena gaṇhantassa gahaṇaṃ asamapekkhanaṃ.

examples.text: manāpe rūpe rāgaṃ, amanāpe dosaṃ, asamapekkhite mohan'ti evaṃ rāg'ādikilese anuppādento upekkhakabhāvena sahati.

9519.meaning1: wrong time; inopportune time; inappropriate occasion

examples.text: pañc'ime, bhikkhave, asamayā padhānāya. katame pañca? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu jiṇṇo hoti jarāy'ābhibhūto. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo asamayo padhānāya.

examples.text: so tena ñāṇadassanena na majjati nappamajjati na pamādaṃ āpajjati, appamatto samāno asamayavimokkhaṃ ārādheti. aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, anavakāso yaṃ so bhikkhu tāya asamayavimuttiyā parihāyetha.

9521.meaning1: permanent emancipation; lasting release; abiding liberation

examples.text: so tena ñāṇadassanena na majjati nappamajjati na pamādaṃ āpajjati, appamatto samāno asamayavimokkhaṃ ārādheti. aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, anavakāso yaṃ so bhikkhu tāya asamayavimuttiyā parihāyetha.

examples.text: so tena ñāṇadassanena na majjati nappamajjati na pamādaṃ āpajjati, appamatto samāno asamayavimokkhaṃ ārādheti. aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, anavakāso yaṃ so bhikkhu tāya asamayavimuttiyā parihāyetha.

9523.commentary: (ANa) asamo'ti appaṭipuggalattā'va sabbasattehi asamo. asamasamo'ti asamā vuccanti atīt'ānāgatā sabbaññubuddhā, tehi asamehi samo'ti asamasamo.

examples.text: ekapuggalo, bhikkhave, loke uppajjamāno uppajjati adutiyo asahāyo appaṭimo appaṭisamo appaṭibhāgo appaṭipuggalo asamo asamasamo dvipadānaṃ aggo. katamo ekapuggalo?
iti asamavekkhitaṃ vā dhammaṃ paññāya samavekkhissāmi, samavekkhitaṃ vā dhammaṃ tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmī'ti, ajjhattaṃ'y'eva sati sūpaṭṭhitā hoti.

na > a + saṃ + ava + √ikkh + itvā
na + samavekkhitvā

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, māgadhako gopālako duppaññajātiko, vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye, asamavekkhitvā gaṅgāya nadiyā orimaṃ tīraṃ, asamavekkhitvā pārimaṃ tīraṃ, atitthen'eva gāvo patāresi uttaraṃ tīraṃ suvidehānaṃ.

ye vā pan'assa te honti atthakāmā hitakāmā phāsukakāmā yogakkhemakāmā mātā vā pitā vā bhātā vā bhaginī vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñātisālohitā vā, yā tehi saddhiṃ asaṅgati asamāgamo asamodhānaṃ amissībhāvo, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, piyehi vippayogo dukkho.

duppabbajjaṃ durabhiramaṃ, durāvāsā gharā dukhā, dukkho-asamāna-saṃvāso, dukkh'ānupatit'addhagū, tasmā na c'addhagū siyā, na ca dukkh'ānupatito siyā.
asamānarūpā saramhā paro saro vā lupyate.

examples.text: ettha dāni āyasmanto idañ'ca veyyākaraṇaṃ imesañ'ca dhammānaṃ asamāpatti, idaṃ no, āvuso, kathan'ti? paññāvimuttā kho mayaṃ, āvuso susimā'ti.

9534.meaning1: not entered; not reached; not attained; not achieved

9535.meaning1: not attained before; not previously achieved
9535.commentary: (UDa) asamāpannapubbā'ti rūpasamāpatti arūpasamāpatti brahmavihārasamāpatti nirodhasamāpatti phalasamāpattī'ti evaṃ pabhedā sāvakasādhāraṇā yā kāci samāpattiyo nāma, tāsu ekā'pi samāpatti na sulabharūpā, dullabhā, n'atthi'y'eva sā tena lakuṇḍakabhaddiyena bhikkhunā asamāpannapubbā. eten'assa yaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: eso kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mah'iddhiko mah'ānubhāvo, na ca sā samāpatti sulabharūpā yā tena bhikkhunā asamāpannapubbā. yassa c'atthāya kulaputtā samma'd'eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī'ti.

samāhitassāyaṃ dhammo, n'āyaṃ dhammo asamāhitassa

atha kho te bhikkhū saṃviggā lomahaṭṭhajātā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu, acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho! nivātañ'ca vata ayañ'ca migāramātupāsādo gambhīranemo sunikhāto acalo asampakampī, atha ca pana saṅkampito sampakampito sampacālito'ti!

ime pana dhammayog'amhā, dhammayog'amhā'ti uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā muṭṭhassatī asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā pākat'indriyā

taṃ tattha suvānadoṇiyaṃ suvānapiṇḍam'iva dantamusalehi koṭṭetvā jivhāya samparivattiyamānaṃ jivh'āgge tanupasannakheḷo makkheti, vemajjhato paṭṭhāya bahalakheḷo makkheti, dantakaṭṭhena asampattaṭṭhāne dantagūthako makkheti.

examples.text: ye te kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā asamphuṭṭhā asamphuṭṭhapubbā, na ca phusasi, na ca te hoti phuseyyan'ti? atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

9567.meaning1: not related; not connected; not associated
9567.commentary: (KVt) kenaci ākārena asambaddhāyā'ti bhātu-bhagini-bhāgineyya-putta-paputt'ādīsu yena kenaci ākārena asambaddhāya. pitā, pitupitā, tassa pitā, tassā'pi pitā'ti evaṃ yāva sattamā yugā, pitā, pitumātā, tassā pitā ca mātā ca bhātā ca bhaginī ca, puttā ca, dhītaro cā'ti evam'pi uddhañca adho ca yāva sattamā yugā, pitā, pitubhātā, pitubhaginī, pituputtā, pitudhītaro, tesam'pi puttadhītuparam'parā'ti evam'pi yāva sattamā yugā, mātā, mātumātā, tassā mātā, tassā'pi mātā'ti evaṃ yāva sattamā yugā, mātā, mātupitā, tassa pitā ca mātā ca bhātā ca bhaginī ca puttā ca dhītaro cā'ti evam'pi uddhañ'ca adho ca yāva sattamā yugā, mātā, mātubhātā, mātubhaginī, mātuputtā, mātudhītaro, tesam'pi puttadhītuparam'parā'ti evam'pi yāva sattamā yugā, tāva n'eva mātusambandhena, na pitusambandhena yā sambaddhā, sā aññātikā nāmā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: aññātikā nāma mātito vā pitito vā yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā asambaddhā.

9568.meaning1: (gram) not constructible; having an unsuitable construction

examples.text: mettañ'ca sabbalokasmi, mānasaṃ bhāvaye aparimāṇaṃ, uddhaṃ adho ca tiriyañ'ca, asambādhaṃ averam'asapattaṃ.
avijjā'ti dukkhe aññāṇaṃ… yaṃ evarūpaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ anabhisamayo ananubodho asambodho appaṭivedho asaṃgāhanā apariyogāhanā asamapekkhanā

dvattikkhattuṃ kho bhavaṃ gotamo mukhe ālopaṃ samparivattetvā ajjhoharati, na c'assa kāci odanamiñjā asambhinnā kāyaṃ pavisati, na c'assa kāci odanamiñjā mukhe avasiṭṭhā hoti, ath'āparaṃ ālopaṃ upanāmeti.
samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo uccā kulā pabbajito asambhinnā khattiyakulā

9574.meaning1: family of the warrior caste with an unbroken lineage
9574.meaning2: family of the ruling case with an unbroken lineage

examples.text: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo uccā kulā pabbajito asambhinnakhattiyakulā…

9575.commentary: (SNt) asambhinnapadan'ti avomissakapadaṃ, aññattha evaṃ anāgataṃ vākyan'ti attho. ten'āha aññattha hi evaṃ vuttaṃ nāma n'atthī'ti.

examples.text: ākāse pāṇiṃ cālesī'ti nīle gagan'antare yamakavijjutaṃ cārayamāno viya heṭṭhābhāgaṃ uparibhāgaṃ ubhatopassesu pāṇiṃ sañcāresi. idañ'ca pana tepiṭake buddhavacane asambhinnapadaṃ nāma.
yo pana bhikkhu asammato bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

9578.grammar: ind, adv, from na sammā, neg
9578.meaning1: not completely; not thoroughly; not fully; not totally

9579.grammar: prp of na sammā paripaccati, comp vb

9580.meaning1: not perfectly awakened; not fully enlightened

examples.text: asammāsambuddhā'va pana te, pāpima, samānā sammāsambuddh'āmhā'ti paṭijāniṃsu. ahaṃ kho pana, pāpima, sammāsambuddho'va samāno sammāsambuddho'mhī'ti paṭijānāmi.

9581.meaning1: not taught by a perfectly awakened Buddha

examples.text: evarūpe kho, bhikkhave, dhammavinaye yo satthari pataṃ kissa hetu? evañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti yathā taṃ durakkhāte dhammavinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasamasaṃvattanike asammāsambuddhappavedite.

9582.meaning1: teaching and training not taught by a perfectly awakened Buddha
9582.sanskrit: na + samyak + sambuddha + pravedita + dharma + vinaya

9584.grammar: ind, adv, fem instr sg of na sammuti, irreg, neg
9584.meaning1: not according to common consensus; not in harmony with popular opinion
9584.meaning2: not according to common consensus; not in harmony with popular opinion
9584.construction:
na > a + saṃ + √mun + ti + iyā
asammuti + iyā > sammuccā

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, māṇava, ye te kosalakā brāhmaṇamahāsālā, seyyath'idaṃ, caṅkī brāhmaṇo tārukkho brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti brāhmaṇo jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo pitā ca te todeyyo, katamā nesaṃ seyyo, yaṃ vā te sammuccā vācaṃ bhāseyyuṃ yaṃ vā asammuccā'ti? sammuccā, bho gotama.
āraddhaṃ kho pana me, brāhmaṇa, vīriyaṃ ahosi asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ek'aggaṃ.
yesaṃ dhammā asammuṭṭhā, paravādesu na nīyare, te sambuddhā samma'd'aññā, caranti visame saman'ti.

9586.construction: na > a + saṃ + √muh + ta > mūḍha > mūḷha

examples.text: yassa kassaci, aggivessana, ye āsavā saṃkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā pahīnā, tam'ahaṃ asammūḷho'ti vadāmi. āsavānañ'hi, aggivessana, pahānā asammūḷho hoti.
tuvaṭaṃ cittaṃ samādhiyati, mukhavaṇṇo vippasīdati, asammūḷho kālaṃ karoti, uttari appaṭivijjhanto brahmalok'ūpago hoti.
tīhi vijjāhi sampannaṃ, asammūḷhavihārinaṃ, buddhaṃ antimadehinaṃ, taṃ namassanti gotamaṃ.
uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati, ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sammāvāyāmo.
taṇhakkhay'ādhimuttassa, asammohañ'ca cetaso, disvā āyatan'uppādaṃ, sammā cittaṃ vimuccati.
so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti, nekkhamm'ādhimutto hoti, pavivek'ādhimutto hoti, abyāpajj'ādhimutto hoti, taṇhākkhay'ādhimutto hoti, upādānakkhay'ādhimutto hoti, asammoh'ādhimutto hoti.

9590.meaning1: not deluded in nature; completely unconfused

examples.text: asammohadhammo satto loke uppanno bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lok'ānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan'ti.

9591.meaning1: unconfused attentiveness; clear awareness without distraction
9591.commentary: (MNt) sātthakassa sampajānanaṃ sātthakasampajaññaṃ. sappāyassa attano upakār'āvahassa hitassa sampajānanaṃ sappāyasampajaññaṃ abhikkam'ādīsu bhikkhācāragocare, aññatth'āpi ca pavattesu avijahite kammaṭṭhānasaṅkhāte gocare sampajaññaṃ gocarasampajaññaṃ. abhikkam'ādīsu asammuyhanam'eva sampajaññaṃ asammohasampajaññaṃ.

examples.text: so hi abhikkant'ādīsu sampajaññaṃ karot'eva, na katthaci sampajaññavirahito hoti. tattha sātthakasampajaññaṃ sappāyasampajaññaṃ gocarasampajaññaṃ asammohasampajaññan'ti catubbidhaṃ sampajaññaṃ.

9592.meaning1: habituated to mental clarity; established in non-delusion; firmly entrenched in an unconfused state

examples.text: so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti, nekkhamm'ādhimutto hoti, pavivek'ādhimutto hoti, abyāpajj'ādhimutto hoti, taṇhākkhay'ādhimutto hoti, upādānakkhay'ādhimutto hoti, asammoh'ādhimutto hoti.

9593.meaning1: not done by oneself; not one's own doing
9593.commentary: (DNa) asayaṃkāroti asayaṃ kato. (UDa) asayaṃkāro aparaṃkāro'ti n'atthi etassa sayaṃkāro'ti asayaṃkāro, n'atthi etassa parakāro'ti aparakāro.

examples.text: sayaṅ'kataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ… paraṅ'kataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ… sayaṅ'katañ'ca paraṅ'katañ'ca sukhadukkhaṃ… asayaṅ'kāraṃ aparaṅ'kāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti.

9594.meaning1: not done by oneself; not one's own doing
9594.commentary: (DNa) asayaṃkāroti asayaṃ kato. (UDa) asayaṃkāro aparaṃkāro'ti n'atthi etassa sayaṃkāro'ti asayaṃkāro, n'atthi etassa parakāro'ti aparakāro.

examples.text: santi pan'āvuso sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti.
kiṃ nu kho, āvuso sāriputta, sayaṃkataṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ, paraṃkataṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ, sayaṃkatañ'ca paraṃkatañ'ca jarāmaraṇaṃ, udāhu asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ jarāmaraṇan'ti?

9595.meaning1: out of control; unable to control oneself
9595.commentary: (DNa) saṅkuddho asayaṃ vase'ti suṭṭhu kuddho kupito kañci vase vattetuṃ asakkonto asayaṃvase asayaṃvasī attano vasena akāmako hutvā nivatto. (DNt) mānusakaṃ vā attano vase vattetuṃ asakkonto asayaṃvase sayañ'ca na attano vase ṭhito. ten'āha asayaṃvasī'ti-ādi.

examples.text: yathā pāvussako megho, thanayanto savijjuko, tadā so paccudāvatti, saṅkuddho asayaṃvase.

9596.meaning1: out of control; unable to control oneself
9596.commentary: (DNt) kañcī'ti tasmiṃ samāgame kañci devataṃ, mānusakaṃ vā attano vase vattetuṃ asakkonto asayaṃvase sayañ'ca na attano vase ṭhito. ten'āha asayaṃvasī'ti-ādi.

examples.text: yathā pāvussako megho, thanayanto savijjuko, tadā so paccudāvatti, saṅkuddho asayaṃvasī.
kacci, bhante, bhagavā sukham'asayitthā'ti? evaṃ, kumāra, sukham'asayitthaṃ. ye ca pana loke sukhaṃ senti, ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataro'ti.
tathāgataṃ buddham'asayhasāhinaṃ, duve vitakkā samudācaranti naṃ, khemo vitakko paṭhamo udīrito, tato viveko dutiyo pakāsito.

so hi yasmā raho paṭicchanne ṭhāne lañjaṃ gahetvā kūṭavinicchayena pākaṭaṃ dosaṃ karonto sāmike assāmike akāsi, tasm'āssa rahassaṃ aṅgaṃ pākaṭaṃ nibbattaṃ. yasmā daṇḍaṃ paṭṭhapento paresaṃ asayhaṃ bhāraṃ āropesi, tasm'āssa rahassaṃ aṅgaṃ asayhabhāro hutvā nibbattaṃ.
